hero.badge: WhatsApp Business Cloud API · Ready to use
hero.title: WhatsApp for your software.
hero.subtitle: SDK widget, REST API and real-time webhooks. Your clients connect to WhatsApp Business in a day — without touching Meta.

sdk.title: SDK Widget
sdk.description: Paste 3 lines into your software. Your clients connect to WhatsApp Business on their own, without you dealing with OAuth or Meta tokens.

api.title: REST API
api.description: Send template messages, receive notifications, manage connections. A clean JSON API authenticated with API Keys.

webhook.title: Real-time Webhooks
webhook.description: Every message and status change reaches your endpoint in milliseconds. Zero polling, zero message storage on our end.

coexistence.title: Coexistence
coexistence.description: Your clients keep the WhatsApp Business app on their phones. Receive on mobile, send via API — in parallel, without conflicts.

DEVELOPER.description: To get started and test the integration.

TEAM.description: For teams with a few active clients.

AGENCY.description: For software houses with multiple clients.
